text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated warmup failures detected for model loads in us-east-1. Alert group: warmup-load-errors. thread 3241112222

mina_oncall: I'm on it. getting repeated OOMs during model deserialization on gpu-node-13. log:
```
[2026-03-15T09:03:12Z] loader: allocation failed: cudaMalloc failed (out of memory) trying to reserve 10.8 GiB
artifact: /registry/open/ig-70b/shard-23.bin size=38.4GB
error: io: unexpected EOF while reading
```

isha_sre: autoscaler ramped 40 warmup pods after a transient control-plane glitch ~09:01. looks like a warmup storm against a partially-corrupt shard -> node ping-pongs

leo_runtime: also seeing deserial gzip errors on the same shard: `gzip: invalid header` and downstream `protobuf: unexpected EOF`. When deserial fails we fallback to JIT compile path which triggers long nvrtc waits: `nvrtc: compiled kernel timed out after 90s`

mona_support: customer impact: several customers reported higher 5xx rate. Major affected: fintech-xcorp (latency-sensitive). Creating support incident FIN-1029 and notifying account team

pat_pm: marking this as P1 due to paid customer impact + error burst. Keep me posted on ETA

oliver_enginfra: temporary mitigation plan: 1) pause autoscaler warmups for model ig-70b 2) block pulls of the suspect shard from registry mirrors 3) cordon/evacuate gpu-node-13 if OOMs continue

mina_oncall: executing step 1: scaling down warmup-targets for that model. Also enqueuing artifact isolation: `registry block shard-23`

incident-bot: action recorded: `warmup-suspend` applied by mina_oncall at 09:07 UTC

leo_runtime: mitigation 2: flip runtime flag `--disable-nvrtc` for new warmups to avoid JIT compile stalls. This will force use of precompiled kernels (where available) or fall back to CPU compile (slower)

isha_sre: rolling `--disable-nvrtc` to warmup pool alpha as a canary now

mina_oncall: routing traffic: shift new loads to `ig-70b-q4` quantized variant where we have prevalidated artifacts; also reduce concurrent load per rack from 6 -> 2 to limit memory pressure

oliver_enginfra: started mirror checksum sweep across registry replicas. found 2 mirrors with mismatched sha256 for shard-23. Taking them out of rotation

leo_runtime: increased model load timeout for PVC artifacts from 60s -> 180s so slow deserials don't cascade into JIT timeouts. Also added immediate fail-on-corrupt check to abort load early

isha_sre: after stash of warmups + disable-nvrtc + mirror quarantine, OOM alarms decreased significantly. node ping rate stopped, error rate trending down

mona_support: fintech-xcorp reported intermittent 502s earlier but now mostly recovered. CS offered interim status; finance notified for SLA review

pat_pm: next steps: durable fixes in 72h. Need artifact validation on publish and registry GC safety window tweak. Also consider autoscaler backoff policy to prevent warmup storms

oliver_enginfra: filed infra ticket INF-7582: "registry mirror write-atomicity and gc window". Owner: oliver_enginfra. Target: 72h

leo_runtime: runtime followups: 1) enforce gzip header check during fetch 2) abort warmup on validation fail 3) implement dynamic compile timeout based on node load. Filed ticket RUNTIME-3312

mina_oncall: prepping handoff to night oncall @tess_night. Summary: corrupted shard-23 caused deserial failures -> JIT compile timeouts -> node OOMs -> warmup storm. Mitigations applied: suspended warmups, blocked shard mirrors, disabled nvrtc for warmups, routed to quantized variant, reduced concurrency, increased load timeout, cordon plan ready. Monitoring in place

tess_night: taking over. I'll monitor until 12:00 UTC, continue mirror sweep, and coordinate with registry team first thing. Will post updates here.

incident-bot: incident status -> MITIGATED (post-mitigation monitoring active). state saved as incident-3241112222

mona_support: offered fintech-xcorp a goodwill credit and weekly status updates until full patch deployed

pat_pm: owners assigned: registry=oliver_enginfra, runtime=leo_runtime, autoscale=isha_sre. Target resolution ETA: 72 hours

mina_oncall: post-incident metrics: peak 5xx rate 18% -> 2.4% after mitigations; impacted customers ~5; cordoned nodes 0 (cordon prepared but not needed). Closing loop for now :white_check_mark:
